"""Frozen exploratory scalar Galerkin diagnostic; not a source certificate."""
from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import sys,json,traceback,tempfile
root=Path('C:/Users/dfred/Desktop/Projects/IGH/quantyra-wormhole-semiclassical')
sys.path.insert(0,'C:/Users/dfred/AppData/Local/Temp/s169af-arb')
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'checks'))
import current_schur_bolt_functional as prev
from flint import arb,arb_mat,ctx
import mpmath as mp
local=prev.local; Poly=local.Poly; zp=local.monomial
def dec(x): return x.str(22)
folder=Path(tempfile.gettempdir()); path=Path(__file__)
out=folder/'s169bc-scalar-probe.json'
run={'start':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'source':path.read_text(),'source_sha256':sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 'scope':'Exploratory actual scalar Galerkin approximation and strong residual; no reduced-source or continuum certificate.',
 'degrees':[8,12,16], 'precision_bits':512,'rows':[]}
try:
 ctx.prec=512;mp.mp.dps=55
 p,h,zh,env=prev.york.actual_parameters()
 Q=Poly({(power,0):env[sym] for power,sym in zip(prev.york.powers,prev.york.qs)})
 trial=local.physical_trials(Q)[-1]
 brow=sum(local.trace_row_variation(p,Q,trial).values(),Poly(0))
 for n in run['degrees']:
  basis=[zp(k+4) for k in range(n)]
  mat=arb_mat([[sum(local.scalar_covariant(p,Q,a,b).values(),Poly(0)).integral(zh).mid() for b in basis] for a in basis])
  rhs=arb_mat([[-(brow*a).integral(zh).mid()] for a in basis])
  coeff=mat.solve(rhs); u=sum((basis[i]*coeff[i,0].mid() for i in range(n)),Poly(0))
  au=sum(local.trace_row_variation(p,Q,{'nu':u,'u':Poly(0)}).values(),Poly(0))
  residual=au+brow
  r2=(zp(4)*residual**2).integral(zh)
  record={'n':n,'u_bolt':dec(u.value(zh)),'residual_mass_norm_squared':dec(r2),
   'residual_coefficient_sum':dec(sum((c.abs_upper() for c in residual.c.values()),arb(0))),
   'u_samples':{str(z):dec(u.value(arb(str(z)))) for z in [.1,.3,.5,.7,.9,.99]},
   'u_coefficients':u.serialized(),'residual_coefficients':residual.serialized()}
  run['rows'].append(record);print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in record.items() if not k.endswith('coefficients')}),flush=True)
 run['status']='complete'
except Exception:
 run['status']='failed';run['error']=traceback.format_exc();print(run['error'])
run['finished']=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
receipt=json.loads(out.read_bytes()) if out.exists() else {'runs':[]}
receipt['runs'].append(run);out.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'status':run['status'],'receipt':str(out)}))
